subbench.objective: Log-line search over mostly-FAILING text: what an engine pays to establish that a chunk of log lines does NOT contain the shape an operator is grepping for, at the sizes a log shipper hands a matcher (256 B - 4 KB) and across a size sweep to 1 MB. The set contains both cases the answer turns on -- patterns whose match requires a literal byte, which a required-byte precheck can dismiss a subject on, and patterns built only from classes, which no such precheck can help.
